university: University of Puerto Rico, Rio Piedras

documents.title: Circular 8 (2024-2025) Lineamientos y guías para la integración y uso de la Inteligencia Artificial (IA) en los proyectos académicos y de investigación del Recinto de Río Piedras
documents.stance_why: The circular sets no single campus rule; it offers "cinco (5) niveles de uso" and tells each professor to "seleccione y adapte" the level that fits the course, while fixing campus-wide duties (declare AI use, no AI on supervised exams, state the level in syllabus). Because it offers tiers, the stance is delegates.
tiers: Nivel 2: Uso Moderado (Apoyo en el Proceso)
documents.summary: A January 2025 circular from the Rio Piedras academic affairs dean that adopts the five-level AI Assessment Scale with sample Spanish syllabus text for each level. It requires every syllabus and assignment to state its AI level, requires students to declare AI use and sign an integrity agreement, bans AI on supervised exams, and routes misuse through the academic integrity policy.

units.why: It says the guidelines are the product of the AI Working Group and the Academic Integrity Council: how the policy was made (P84).
units.anchor: producto de las discusiones y reflexiones desarrolladas por el Grupo de Trabajo sobre la IA

units.why: It states AI "puede enriquecer el aprendizaje y facilitar enseñanza, la investigación", naming benefits without a rule, so P87.
units.anchor: ofreciendo herramientas innovadoras que pueden enriquecer el aprendizaje y facilitar enseñanza
units.frag_start: La IA está transformando el panorama

units.why: The circular defines AI as "máquinas capaces de imitar ciertas funcionalidades de la inteligencia humana", which sets what the guidelines cover; a scope definition goes to P61.
units.anchor: definimos IA como máquinas[4] capaces de imitar ciertas funcionalidades de la inteligencia humana

units.why: The circular says AI should be integrated "de manera ética, responsable y alineada con nuestros valores institucionales", an institution-level statement of purpose and principles (P56).
units.resolution_why: Actor: A admin, B all. The sentence is the issuing office speaking for the institution ("reconocemos la importancia de integrar estas herramientas de manera ética, responsable"), a commitment by the campus, so admin. Type P56, modality informs and stance encourage agreed.
units.anchor: integrar estas herramientas de manera ética, responsable y alineada con nuestros valores institucionales
units.frag_start: En la Universidad de Puerto Rico, Recinto

units.why: Integration is meant "para promover el pensamiento crítico y el diseño de actividades educativas innovadoras", a claimed benefit for learning with no rule attached, so P87 (benefits of AI for learning); P44 does not fit because no professional or employer skill is named.
units.resolution_why: Type: A P44 (with a fit_note saying it frames AI integration as meeting the needs of 21st-century students and critical thinking with no explicit employer or professional-skill claim), B P87. The source gives a learning benefit ("promover el pensamiento crítico"), not a professional-skill claim, so P87 fits fully and A's fit_note no longer applies. Actor: A admin, B all; same sentence as unit 4 (institution speaking), so admin.
units.anchor: promover el pensamiento crítico y el diseño de actividades educativas innovadoras

units.why: The circular states its purpose: "establecer guías generales para integrar la IA en los procesos de enseñanza, aprendizaje e investigación", an institution-wide framework preamble (P56).
units.anchor: establecer guías generales para integrar la IA en los procesos de enseñanza, aprendizaje e investigación

units.why: The second stated aim is to guide the community on "mantener los lineamientos de integridad académica"; this sets the purpose of the framework (P56).
units.anchor: orientar a la comunidad académica sobre estrategias para mantener los lineamientos de integridad académica

units.why: The third aim "Establecer que todo prontuario o sílabo de curso incluya el nivel de uso" makes a syllabus AI statement mandatory (P09).
units.resolution_why: Phase: A before-course, B course-start. The rule is what a syllabus must say to students, which the codebook places under course-start (communicating expectations). Policy wording: A wrote it too; B's wording is kept as it matches the passage ("todo prontuario o sílabo de curso incluya el nivel de uso").
units.anchor: todo prontuario o sílabo de curso incluya el nivel de uso
units.policy: Every course syllabus must include the level of use of the AI tools policy.

units.why: The circular requires the instructions of each assignment or evaluation to "especifique claramente si se permite el uso de IA, y bajo qué condiciones"; assignment-level statement fits P09.
units.resolution_why: Policy wording: A left policy null, B normalized. The anchor alone omits the "must" and the object (each assignment or evaluation), so B's faithful statement is used. Codes agreed.
units.anchor: se especifique claramente si se permite el uso de IA, y bajo qué condiciones específicas
units.policy: The instructions of each assignment or evaluation must specify clearly whether AI use is permitted and under what specific conditions.

units.why: It proposes "cinco (5) niveles de uso" on the AIAS scale: named levels, so P05.
units.resolution_why: Phase and modality: A before-course/should, B general/informs. The circular "se propone" five levels "para facilitar la toma de decisiones" by instructors, a proposal about how to set rules, so before-course and should. Type P05 agreed.
units.anchor: se propone el establecimiento de cinco (5) niveles de uso
units.frag_start: Para facilitar la toma de decisiones

units.why: Level 0 says "No se permite el uso de herramientas de la IA en ninguna parte del proceso de enseñanza-aprendizaje", a full ban. Chosen over P05 because a reader looking for a no-AI rule finds it in P01, while the tier structure itself is coded in the P05 unit; P01 is only a partial fit because Level 0 is an option, not a default.
units.resolution_why: Type: A P05 (a prohibition tier, not a default ban), B P01 with a fit_note that it applies only where a course adopts Level 0. The source states a plain ban ("No se permite ... en ninguna parte"), and the tier-structure statement is already coded under P05 (the "cinco niveles" unit), so P01 with a fit_note is used. Phase: A during-work, B general; the ban governs students' work in the course, so during-work.
units.anchor: No se permite el uso de herramientas de la IA en ninguna parte
units.fit_note: Level 0 is one tier an instructor may adopt for a course or activity, not the campus default; P01 is the nearest type, the ban itself is stated.

units.why: Level 0 justification says it applies where "la originalidad y el esfuerzo personal son esenciales"; a reason for limiting AI that protects personal effort, nearest P41.
units.anchor: la originalidad y el esfuerzo personal son esenciales para la evaluación del aprendizaje
units.frag_start: Se aplica a tareas o actividades
units.fit_note: Rationale is originality and personal effort for fair assessment rather than explicit skill-building.

units.why: Level 0 lists "Exámenes administrados de modo presencial o en línea" as no-AI activities, so exams are AI-free (P22).
units.anchor: Exámenes administrados de modo presencial o en línea.

units.why: The sample Level 0 syllabus text says all assessment must be completed "sin asistencia de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial"; no AI on assessment instruments (P22).
units.anchor: deberán completarse sin asistencia de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial
units.frag_start: En este curso, todas las técnicas

units.why: The sample says "Cualquier uso de la IA ... será considerado una violación de las normas de integridad académica", classing unauthorized AI as misconduct (P36).
units.anchor: será considerado una violación de las normas de integridad académica

units.why: Level 1 permits AI "únicamente para consultas generales, como generación de ideas, investigación inicial o revisión de conceptos básicos"; brainstorming leads the list so P15.
units.anchor: únicamente para consultas generales, como generación de ideas, investigación inicial o revisión de conceptos básicos
units.frag_start: Se permite el uso de las herramientas
units.fit_note: Also covers initial research and reviewing basic concepts, limited to general consultation. | Also covers initial research and review of basic concepts, and limits AI to these general queries only.

units.why: Level 1 justification: "limitando el impacto directo de la IA en los trabajos académicos o productos finales"; a reason for limiting AI to protect critical thinking, nearest P41.
units.resolution_why: Actor and phase: A instructor/before-course, B all/general. The Justificación sits inside a tier an instructor selects for a course, like the Level 0 rationale both coders coded instructor/before-course, so A is used for consistency. Type P41 agreed.
units.anchor: limitando el impacto directo de la IA en los trabajos académicos o productos finales
units.fit_note: The reason is fostering critical thinking and limiting AI influence on the final product, not explicitly that practice builds skill.

units.why: Level 1 requires students to "citar el uso de herramientas de IA en las referencias del trabajo", a per-submission citation (P24).
units.resolution_why: Unit stance: A require, B neutral. This disclosure or documentation duty is a condition attached to a level that permits AI use; it does not require using AI and does not ban it, so the stance toward AI use is permit. Type P24, actor, phase and modality agreed.
units.anchor: El estudiantado debe citar el uso de herramientas de IA en las referencias

units.why: Level 1 example: examples to understand a topic; tutor-like use for understanding concepts, so P12.
units.resolution_why: Found only by B. Source: Level 1 lists "Consulta para generar ejemplos o comprender un tema" as a permitted activity, which is tutor-like use for understanding a topic. Real permission, kept as P12.
units.anchor: Consulta para generar ejemplos o comprender un tema.

units.why: Level 1 sample text allows AI only "para actividades previas a una tarea", such as brainstorming and planning; nearest P15 but the limit to pre-task use is extra.
units.resolution_why: Found only by B. Source: the Level 1 sample syllabus text permits AI "únicamente para actividades previas a una tarea o un trabajo académico", a narrower and different rule from the Level 1 description (A's P32 unit only mentioned it in its why). Kept as P15 with B's fit_note.
units.anchor: únicamente para actividades previas a una tarea o un trabajo académico
units.fit_note: AI is limited to pre-task activities (brainstorming, planning, initial research), not only brainstorming.

units.why: The Level 1 sample text allows AI "únicamente para actividades previas a una tarea" and says the final submission must show independent development; this keeps the student as primary problem-solver (P32).
units.anchor: la presentación final debe demostrar claramente cómo ha(s) desarrollado y refinado estas
units.frag_start: Sin embargo, la presentación final debe
units.fit_note: AI is limited to pre-task activities; the final work must show independent development.

units.why: The Level 1 sample text requires "una breve declaración en la tarea o el trabajo explicando cómo se utilizó la IA", a disclosure statement (P24).
units.resolution_why: Unit stance: A require, B neutral. This disclosure or documentation duty is a condition attached to a level that permits AI use; it does not require using AI and does not ban it, so the stance toward AI use is permit. Type P24, actor, phase and modality agreed.
units.anchor: Se requiere incluir una breve declaración en la tarea o el trabajo

units.why: Level 2 permits AI as support "como revisar la gramática, estructurar ideas o realizar traducciones": editing and writing support (P91).

units.frag_start: Se permite el uso de la IA como apoyo

units.why: Level 2 rationale: productivity "sin reemplazar el esfuerzo cognitivo y creativo principal del estudiante"; student stays the main thinker, so P32.
units.resolution_why: Found only by B. Source: the Level 2 Justificación gives as aim productivity "sin reemplazar el esfuerzo cognitivo y creativo principal del estudiante". Real rationale statement, kept as P32 (informs). Actor and phase changed from B's all/general to instructor/before-course to match how the other Justificación units inside tiers are coded.
units.anchor: sin reemplazar el esfuerzo cognitivo y creativo principal del estudiante
units.frag_start: Fomentar la revisión y el mejoramiento técnico

units.why: Level 2 requires "Declaración explícita del uso de la IA, incluyendo cómo y dónde se aplicó", disclosure with details of where it was used (P24).
units.resolution_why: Unit stance: A require, B neutral. This disclosure or documentation duty is a condition attached to a level that permits AI use; it does not require using AI and does not ban it, so the stance toward AI use is permit. Type P24, actor, phase and modality agreed.
units.anchor: Declaración explícita del uso de la IA, incluyendo cómo y dónde se aplicó.

units.why: Level 2 example: translating text with DeepL or ChatGPT; prose support, so P91.
units.resolution_why: Found only by B. Source: Level 2 lists "Traducción de texto con herramientas como DeepL o ChatGPT" as an example activity, an AI use the level permits. Kept as P91.
units.anchor: Traducción de texto con herramientas como DeepL o ChatGPT.

units.why: Level 2 sample text permits "generar ideas, redactar textos preliminares, recibir retroalimentación y refinar el trabajo", which includes drafting text with AI; P91 covers writing support.
units.resolution_why: Found only by A. Source: the Level 2 sample text permits AI for "generar ideas, redactar textos preliminares, recibir retroalimentación y refinar el trabajo", a separate permission from the grammar/translation permission in the Level 2 description (B only mentioned it inside the verification unit's why). Kept as a real policy statement.
units.anchor: generar ideas, redactar textos preliminares, recibir retroalimentación y refinar el trabajo

units.why: Level 2 sample text requires the student to "evaluar y modificar críticamente cualquier contenido generado por la IA", verifying AI output (P31).
units.resolution_why: Unit stance: A permit, B restrict. The sentence follows a permission for ideas, preliminary drafts and feedback; the duty to evaluate and modify AI output critically is a condition on that permission, so permit. Type P31 and other codes agreed.
units.anchor: debe(s) evaluar y modificar críticamente cualquier contenido generado por la IA
units.fit_note: Also requires demonstrating deep understanding of the material. | Also requires demonstrating deep understanding of the material, which is P30-like.

units.why: Level 2 requires "una sección en el trabajo indicando cómo se utilizó la IA y cómo se refinaron sus aportes", disclosure within the work (P24).
units.resolution_why: Unit stance: A require, B neutral. This disclosure or documentation duty is a condition attached to a level that permits AI use; it does not require using AI and does not ban it, so the stance toward AI use is permit. Type P24, actor, phase and modality agreed.
units.anchor: Se requiere incluir una sección en el trabajo indicando cómo se utilizó la IA

units.why: Level 3 says "Se permite la colaboración entre el estudiantado y la IA ... siempre que el estudiantado mantenga el control intelectual y evalúe críticamente los resultados"; the main clause is a conditional permission (may), so P02, and the condition on intellectual control is kept in the policy wording and fit_note.
units.resolution_why: Modality and type: A must/P32, B may/P02. The verb of the sentence is "Se permite", so the rule is a permission (may); the condition about intellectual control is the P32 idea but is subordinate ("siempre que"). P02 with a fit_note keeps both. A normalized policy is written so the condition is not lost.
units.anchor: siempre que el estudiantado mantenga el control intelectual y evalúe críticamente
units.frag_start: Se permite la colaboración entre el estudiantado
units.policy: Level 3 permits collaboration between students and AI in the creation process, provided that students keep intellectual control and critically evaluate the results generated by the AI.
units.fit_note: Permission applies only where a course adopts Level 3 and is conditioned on intellectual control and critical evaluation.

units.why: Level 3 justification: promotes "alfabetización digital y el desarrollo de competencias tecnológicas"; learning to use AI as a skill (P44).
units.resolution_why: Actor, phase, stance: A instructor/before-course/encourage, B all/general/neutral. Like the other Justificación units inside a tier, this one is addressed to the instructor choosing the tier; "Promueve la alfabetización digital" favors AI skills, so encourage.
units.anchor: Promueve la alfabetización digital y el desarrollo de competencias tecnológicas en la interacción con IA.

units.why: Level 3 requires a detailed justification of AI use and a critical reflection on results; a reflection submitted with the work, so P26.
units.resolution_why: Policy wording and stance: A left policy null and gave stance require, B wrote a policy covering both requirements ("Justificación detallada del uso de IA ... Reflexión crítica") and stance neutral. The source lists two requirements for Level 3, and B's policy keeps both; stance is permit because they condition a permitted use. Type P26 agreed.
units.anchor: Reflexión crítica sobre la calidad y relevancia de los resultados generados.
units.frag_start: Justificación detallada del uso de IA
units.policy: Level 3 requires a detailed justification of AI use in the process and a critical reflection on the quality and relevance of the generated results.
units.fit_note: Also requires a detailed justification of AI use in the process. | Also requires a justification of the use, not only a reflection.

units.why: Level 3 lists "Desarrollo de borradores de trabajos académicos o proyectos creativos" as an activity; AI-assisted drafting of prose is writing support, so P91 (P16 is about code).
units.resolution_why: Type: A P91, B P16 (nearest, noting it is not code). P16 is defined for AI-generated code; the source concerns drafts of papers and creative projects, which is writing support, so P91.
units.anchor: Desarrollo de borradores de trabajos académicos o proyectos creativos.
units.fit_note: Drafting of papers and creative projects with AI is broader than editing or proofreading; B coded this as P16, noting it concerns prose and not code.

units.why: Level 3 example: graphic or multimedia design proposals from the student's prompts; images and illustrations, so P106.
units.resolution_why: Found only by B. Source: Level 3 lists "Propuestas de diseño gráfico o multimedia basadas en indicaciones del estudiante" as an example activity; permitted AI for images and design, kept as P106.
units.anchor: Propuestas de diseño gráfico o multimedia basadas en indicaciones
units.frag_start: Propuestas de diseño gráfico o multimedia

units.why: Level 3 example activities include "Análisis de datos preliminares o resúmenes de investigación generados por la IA", data analysis with AI (P89).
units.anchor: Análisis de datos preliminares o resúmenes de investigación generados por la IA.

units.why: Level 3 sample text lets students use AI "para realizar investigaciones, redactar, analizar datos y refinar resultados" if they direct and supervise it; broad conditional permission, so P02.
units.resolution_why: Type: A P91, B P02. The sample text permits AI "para realizar investigaciones, redactar, analizar datos y refinar resultados" as long as the student directs and supervises it: a broad conditional permission, not just writing support, so P02 (A's own fit_note said it was broader than editing).
units.anchor: puede(s) emplear herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para realizar investigaciones, redactar
units.fit_note: Permission is conditional on directing and supervising the AI and applies to a course adopting Level 3. Broader than editing: also research and data analysis.

units.why: Sample text requires critical thinking and analytical skills when integrating AI results; student remains accountable thinker, so P32.
units.resolution_why: Found only by B. Source: the Level 3 sample text says "Debe asegurase de demostrar pensamiento crítico y habilidades analíticas al integrar los resultados generados por la IA", a duty on the student separate from the permission sentence before it. Kept as P32 (student stays the thinker).
units.anchor: demostrar pensamiento crítico y habilidades analíticas al integrar los resultados generados por la IA

units.why: Level 3 sample text requires "una declaración sobre el uso de la IA, especificando cómo contribuyó"; per-submission disclosure (P24).
units.resolution_why: Unit stance: A require, B neutral. This disclosure or documentation duty is a condition attached to a level that permits AI use; it does not require using AI and does not ban it, so the stance toward AI use is permit. Type P24, actor, phase and modality agreed.
units.anchor: Se requiere incluir una declaración sobre el uso de la IA, especificando cómo contribuyó

units.why: Level 4 permits AI "siempre que el estudiantado sea transparente sobre su uso y el enfoque educativo del curso respalde esta práctica": open use with transparency, the permissive default level (P02).
units.anchor: siempre que el estudiantado sea transparente sobre su uso y el enfoque educativo del curso
units.frag_start: Se permite el empleo de herramientas
units.fit_note: Permission is tied to transparency and to the course's educational approach supporting AI use.

units.why: Level 4 suits courses that explore AI "como parte integral de los aprendizajes esperados", AI built into the work (P79).
units.anchor: explorar el potencial de la IA como parte integral de los aprendizajes esperados
units.fit_note: Describes courses where AI is part of learning outcomes; it does not itself require AI use.

units.why: Level 4 requires "Transparencia total sobre el uso de IA y su integración", full disclosure (P24).
units.resolution_why: Unit stance: A require, B neutral. This disclosure or documentation duty is a condition attached to a level that permits AI use; it does not require using AI and does not ban it, so the stance toward AI use is permit. Type P24, actor, phase and modality agreed.
units.anchor: Transparencia total sobre el uso de IA y su integración en la actividad académica.
units.frag_start: Requisitos: Transparencia total sobre el uso

units.why: Level 4 examples include projects on designing and integrating AI; AI as the subject of the work, so P79.
units.resolution_why: Found only by B. Source: Level 4 lists "Proyectos experimentales sobre el diseño e integración de la IA en educación o investigación" as example activities, where AI is the subject of the work. Kept as P79 with B's fit_note.
units.anchor: Proyectos experimentales sobre el diseño e integración de la IA en educación o investigación.
units.fit_note: Lists project types where AI is the object of the work, not an explicit requirement.

units.why: Level 4 example activities include "Creación de contenido multimedia o simulaciones con herramientas de la IA", AI-generated media for coursework; nearest P106.
units.anchor: Creación de contenido multimedia o simulaciones con herramientas de la IA.
units.fit_note: Covers multimedia content and simulations, not only images. | Covers multimedia and simulations, broader than images.

units.why: Level 4 sample text says the course "fomenta el uso creativo y colaborativo de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial", encouraging AI use (P02).
units.anchor: Este curso fomenta el uso creativo y colaborativo de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial

units.why: Sample text invites students to work with the instructor to design approaches integrating AI; jointly designing AI use with the instructor, nearest P79 (AI built into coursework).
units.resolution_why: Type: A P67 (co-create the AI policy with students), B P79. The sample text invites students to "trabajar junto con el profesor o la profesora para diseñar enfoques únicos que integren la IA", i.e. designing AI-integrated approaches to the work, not co-creating the policy, so P79 with B's fit_note (not a requirement). A's fit_note said the same about P67 (co-design is of AI-integrated approaches, not of the policy).
units.anchor: Puede(s) trabajar junto con el profesor o la profesora para diseñar enfoques únicos
units.fit_note: The co-design is of AI-integrated approaches for the work, not of the course AI policy itself. | Students and instructor jointly design AI approaches; not a co-created policy and not a requirement.

units.why: Sample text says it is "fundamental documentar cómo se utilizó la IA" and what impact it had; documentation duty, so P26.
units.resolution_why: Type and stance: A P24, B P26 with a fit_note. "Es fundamental documentar cómo se utilizó la IA ... y qué impacto tuvo en los resultados finales" asks for documentation of use and its impact, close to a reflection or log (P26), beyond a plain per-submission disclosure (P24). Stance permit because it conditions the open use in Level 4.
units.anchor: Es fundamental documentar cómo se utilizó la IA para diseñar estrategias
units.fit_note: Documentation of how AI was used and its impact, not necessarily full transcripts.

units.why: Instructors must "seleccione y adapte el lenguaje del nivel de autorización" matching course objectives: each instructor chooses the level (P04).
units.resolution_why: Found only by A (B merged it into one P83 unit, whose fit_note says it combines instructor choice of tier with alignment to objectives). The sentence "seleccione y adapte el lenguaje del nivel de autorización" instructs instructors to choose and adapt a level, a rule distinct from aligning it with the course objectives (unit coded P83), so kept as its own unit under P04.

units.resolution_why: Coders agreed on codes (P83, instructor, before-course, should).
